parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Newton

Panorama Ridge is an MLS® area in the Newton part of Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs roughly from 64 Avenue south to Highway 99 and the Mud Bay shoreline, and from 120 Street (Scott Road, the Delta border) east to King George Boulevard and the Nicomekl River. The edges are approximate. Panorama Park and Boundary Park are close by, and the City describes both as west Newton parks.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

blocks.text: What to look at in a Panorama Ridge home

parts.t: These are the questions I go through with buyers.
Lot size, the age of the roof, furnace, plumbing and wiring, and drainage
What the zone allows, and whether any suite was built with a permit
Assuming you can add a suite or rebuild just because a neighbour did
Strata fees, the depreciation report (the plan for future repairs), meeting minutes and bylaws
About upcoming special levies (extra one-time charges) and what the fees include

items.t: Pet, rental or age rules that don’t fit your plans

parts.t: ALR status, well water if there is no city water, septic, and how the land drains in winter

items.t: What the zone allows for a second home, outbuildings and animals
Streams and ravines that limit where you can build

parts.t: Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.

Nearby, just east of the MLS® area, East Panorama Ridge, south of Highway 10 between 148 and 152 Street, is a small business park area. Its plan’s land use designations have been replaced by the Official Community Plan.
The plan map also shows streamside buffers of 15 to 30 metres and tree retention areas, which can limit where you build.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Panorama Ridge

parts.t: Ask the City of Surrey how the property is zoned and what the local plan says about it and the lots around it.
Use the Surrey Schools School Locator for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents:
the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Ask whether it was built with a permit before you count on it.
On a larger lot, check the land.
Check ALR status on the ALC map, and ask the City about streams, ravines and any covenants on title.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Send me your address and I’ll give you a call to talk about how to get the most value from your home.

Panorama Ridge is an MLS® area name in the Newton part of Surrey. On the MLS® map its edges are roughly 64 Avenue on the north, 120 Street (Scott Road) on the west, King George Boulevard down to about 56 Avenue and Highway 10 and then the Nicomekl River on the east, and Highway 99 and the Mud Bay and Serpentine Fen shoreline on the south. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
